nodes.label: Portfolio Report Unified
nodes.rationale: Single /portfolio/report call runs engine once and returns dashboard data together, avoiding duplicate calculations, race conditions, and repeated cache misses from separate summary/history/allocation requests.

nodes.label: Inline WAC Computation
nodes.rationale: Portfolio engine now computes WAC inline during daily-state construction so repeated per-position DB lookups disappear and cached engine blobs remain self-contained.

nodes.label: BRIM Import Flow
nodes.rationale: BRIM intentionally separates preview parsing from persistence: upload, detect, parse, match, then reuse standard transaction batch commit after user review.

nodes.label: D-1 Income Eligibility Window
nodes.rationale: Lot income eligibility depends on open quantity at end of prior day, never same-day holdings, so transfers and same-day activity cannot distort dividend or interest attribution.

nodes.label: Deterministic Cost Matching Ladder
nodes.rationale: Asset-linked FEE and TAX pools follow ordered matching ladders so allocation stays deterministic, auditable, and any residual orphan cost is explicit instead of silently dropped.

nodes.label: Unified Batch Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Transaction mutations were collapsed into validate/commit over TXMixedBatch with lenient row parsing, shared validation, and one atomic balance walk instead of many separate endpoints.
